claim: ATT&CK distinguishes revocation (successor exists, typed by a revoked-by edge) from deprecation (no successor), and retains both classes of object in every published bundle.
The March 2020 sub-technique restructuring is the single largest discontinuity in ATT&CK's history and re-identified a large share of the pre-existing technique catalogue.
Published CTI systems, datasets and benchmarks overwhelmingly do not declare which ATT&CK release their labels encode.
sources: B2 audit of six TTP systems

claim: No established CTI quality framework names vocabulary or ontology versioning as a quality dimension.
sources: B5 survey of the quality-dimension literature
B6 boundary analysis of the drift literature

claim: Formal concept-drift theory is defined over a fixed label space and therefore cannot express a change in the label space itself.
Ontology engineering already has the machinery ATT&CK lacks: referent stability rules, exact-versus-inexact successor relations, version IRIs and declared backward compatibility.
Ontology version change has already been shown to change scientific conclusions in another discipline (Gene Ontology).
